external.label: Open the Steve Miller Band desk

body:
A listening desk for the Steve Miller Band, filed on Spinning.

The room is four eras you can open: the San Francisco blues years with Boz Scaggs, the 1973 turn when the old nicknames walk into one song, the Fly Like an Eagle and Book of Dreams peak, and Abracadabra after that. Pick a song and the desk tells you the year, the album, and why the track is on the table. Space Cowboy, Maurice, and the Gangster of Love sit on their own board, because The Joker keeps pointing back at them.

Listen links go out to the band's site, YouTube, and Spotify. A few official videos and label-audio uploads sit in the player. Nothing here transcribes lyrics or keeps a chart. The receipt — which era and which song you last opened — stays in the browser.

The page is /steve-miller-band/. The same desk as JSON is /steve-miller-band.json.
